common_wording: This lease shall automatically renew for a further term of one year unless notice is given 90 days prior.
plain_english: The contract will restart itself for another year if you don't say you want to stop it at least 3 months early.
recommended_action: Negotiate to require written consent for renewal.

common_wording: The Director hereby personally guarantees the performance of all obligations under this agreement.
plain_english: If the business cannot pay, you must pay with your own personal money and assets.
recommended_action: Remove if possible, or limit to a specific amount.

common_wording: Late payments shall attract interest at the rate of 10% per month compounding.
plain_english: If you pay late, they will add a very high extra cost (interest) every month.
recommended_action: Negotiate to reduce to a reasonable annual rate.

common_wording: The parties hereby waive any right to any other jurisdiction and submit to the courts of New York.
plain_english: If there is a problem, you have to go to a court in America, not Nigeria.
recommended_action: Change jurisdiction to Nigeria, specifically the state where you operate.

common_wording: All intellectual property created during the term shall belong exclusively to the Company.
plain_english: Anything you create while working here belongs to the company, not you.
recommended_action: Clarify that this only applies to work done specifically for the company.

common_wording: The Agent shall not provide similar services to any other person or entity in Nigeria.
plain_english: You are not allowed to work for any other person who does this same type of business in Nigeria.
legal_reference: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act (FCCPA)
recommended_action: Limit the exclusivity to specific competitors or a shorter time.

common_wording: Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform due to acts of God, war, or government action.
plain_english: If something big happens that nobody can control (like a natural disaster), nobody is in trouble for not finishing the job.
recommended_action: Ensure 'government action' includes changes in law that affect the contract.

common_wording: The Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client from any and all claims.
plain_english: If someone sues the client because of what you did, you have to pay for the client's lawyers and any fines.
recommended_action: Limit indemnity to claims arising directly from your negligence.

common_wording: Termination by the Client shall require payment of the full contract value as liquidated damages.
plain_english: If you stop the contract early, you still have to pay the full price of the whole job.
recommended_action: Change to only pay for work already done plus a small exit fee.

common_wording: The Employee shall not disclose any information about the Company for a period of 50 years.
plain_english: You must keep everything about the company secret for 50 years after you leave.
recommended_action: Reduce the duration to a more reasonable 2-5 years.

common_wording: Any dispute shall be settled by final and binding arbitration in London.
plain_english: If you fight, you go to a private judge (arbitrator) in London instead of a regular court.
recommended_action: Ensure the location of arbitration is in Nigeria (e.g. Lagos Court of Arbitration).

common_wording: The Client shall pay all invoices within 180 days of receipt.
plain_english: The client can wait up to 6 months before they pay you for your work.
recommended_action: Negotiate for payment within 30 days.

common_wording: The Company reserves the right to change these terms at any time without notice.
plain_english: The company can change the rules whenever they want and they don't have to tell you.
recommended_action: Require a written agreement signed by both parties for any changes.

common_wording: The Company's total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for one month of service.
plain_english: If the company causes a huge problem for you, the most they will ever pay you back is one month's fee.
recommended_action: Increase the limit to be equal to the total contract value or insurance coverage.

common_wording: The Client may enter the Contractor's premises at any time to audit all records.
plain_english: The client can walk into your office whenever they want to look at all your papers and computers.
recommended_action: Require at least 48 hours notice and limit the audit to contract-related documents.

common_wording: The Contractor shall not subcontract any part of the services without prior written consent.
plain_english: You are not allowed to hire someone else to help you do the job unless the client says yes in writing.
recommended_action: Ensure consent cannot be unreasonably withheld.

common_wording: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
plain_english: This contract follows the laws of Nigeria.
recommended_action: Accept.

common_wording: The Employee shall not work for any competitor within a 50km radius for 3 years.
plain_english: After you leave, you cannot get a job with a similar company nearby for the next 3 years.
recommended_action: Reduce the time and distance to what is strictly necessary to protect trade secrets.

common_wording: If any part of this agreement is found invalid, the rest of the agreement remains in force.
plain_english: If a judge says one small rule in this contract is bad, all the other rules still apply.
recommended_action: Accept.

common_wording: This document contains the entire agreement between the parties.
plain_english: Only what is written in this paper counts. Any promises made in person or over the phone don't matter.
recommended_action: Make sure everything important that was told to you is written in the contract.
